Install development dependencies devtools::install_dev_deps(), make sure package passes R CMD check running devtools::check(). R CMD check doesn’t pass cleanly, ’s good idea ask help continuing. Create Git branch pull request (PR). recommend using usethis::pr_init("brief-description--change"). title: Get Compositions From Glydb Data — glydb_compositions
text: mono_type Either "generic" "concrete". Default "concrete". See glyrepr::get_mono_type() details. species string specie names. See glydb_species() available specie names. Default NULL, means glycans species included. glycan_type string glycan types. Can "N", "O-GalNAc", "O-GlcNAc", "O-Man", "O-Fuc", "O-Glc". Default NULL, means glycans types included. mono_range named list filtering compositions monosaccharide counts. element integer vector length 2 specifying minimum maximum count monosaccharide. Monosaccharides specified excluded (count = 0). Use NULL filtering. See examples usage.

title: Get Compositions From Glydb Data — glydb_compositions
text: returned value confidence attribute: numeric vector length result containing log-transformed citation counts glycan glydb_data. multiple glycans aggregated lower-resolution structures compositions, maximum confidence score retained. Note confidence attribute lost vector operation like subsetting. Therefore, used glyanno, returned value modified manually.

Fully Determined GlyTouCan Glycan Data — glydb_data

Unknown species NAs. glycan_type: Glycan type, one "N", "O-GalNAc", "O-GlcNAc", "O-Man", "O-Fuc", "O-Glc".
